title: Stand By for Crime
paragraphs: A 1953 syndicated mystery series starring Glenn Langan as Los Angeles radio newsman Chuck Morgan, who follows crime tips beyond the newsroom and into active investigations.
Syndicated crime series built around Los Angeles radio newsman Chuck Morgan and secretary Carol Curtis. production from 1953.
The run breaks into several distinct periods: 26-program U.S. production (1953 to 1953) and Australian continuation / expanded package (1954).
Names that turn up again and again in the surviving run include Adele Jergens (performer), Glenn Langan (performer), and Bob Reichenbach (producer).

The stories often return to radio news reporting and crime investigation, murder and suspicious death, espionage, subversion and Cold War intrigue, money, theft and insurance schemes, narcotics and organized crime, and kidnapping and coercion.

The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes 1953 U.S. syndicated crime production, Radio newscaster as amateur detective, Expansion from 26 to 52 episodes, and Australian-produced second half.
